name: Sunblooded Prowlers
text: Army marker for the Sunblooded Prowlers. Its battle traits, regiment abilities and enhancements are listed on the army.

name: Hidden Hunters
text: Both Hunters of Huanchi units and the Spawn of Chotec are not set up in the deployment phase: they start in reserve and arrive through Chameleon Ambush.

name: Chameleon Ambush
text: In your movement phase from battle round 3, set this unit up anywhere on the battlefield, every model more than 6" from every enemy unit.

name: Vengeance of Azyr
text: At the end of any turn, roll a dice for each enemy unit that is in combat with a friendly Saurus unit. On a 4+ that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal damage.

name: Scaled Aegis
text: Once per turn for the army, in your hero phase, pick a friendly Saurus unit and roll a dice. On a 3+ it has Ward (6+) until the start of your next turn.

name: Followers of Huanchi
text: Once per turn for the army, in your shooting phase, pick a friendly Skink unit and roll a dice. On a 3+ the ranged weapons of that unit, Companion weapons included, have Crit (Auto-wound) for the rest of the turn.

name: Instinctive Commander
text: In your hero phase, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of the general that is not in combat and roll a dice. On a 3+ that unit can make a Normal Move as if it were your movement phase.

name: Savage Mauling
text: In any combat phase, pick an enemy unit in combat with the general. No Ward rolls can be made for that unit for the rest of the turn.

name: Venomite Swarm
text: In any combat phase, pick an enemy unit in combat with the general. If the general still has its Venomites token, roll a D3. On a 1 the token is removed; on a 2 or 3 the enemy unit suffers that much mortal damage.

name: Blessed by the Old Ones
text: At the end of any turn in which the general has been destroyed, this ability must be used: roll a dice. On a 2+ set up a new unit of just the Sunblood anywhere on the battlefield, every model more than 6" from every enemy unit. That unit is your general.

name: Scaled Protectors
text: While this unit includes its Sunblood: the first damage point that would be allocated to it in each phase is ignored, and add 1 to its control score.

name: Savage Bellow
text: In your hero phase, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit (this unit can pick itself) and roll a dice. On a 3+ the weapons of that unit, Companion weapons included, have Crit (2 Hits) for the rest of the turn.

name: Ordered Cohorts
text: Add 1 to save rolls for this unit while it is contesting an objective you control.

name: Star-Venom
text: In any shooting phase, pick an enemy unit that had damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit's Dartpipe attacks and roll a dice. On a 2+ subtract 1 from the wound rolls of that unit's combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

name: Nerve-Shredding Screeches
text: In any combat phase, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and roll a dice. On a 4+ subtract 1 from the hit rolls of that unit's combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

name: Sun Acolytes
text: This unit starts with 3 Sun Acolyte tokens. Add 1 to its control score for each token it still has; with none left its control score is at most 1. Each unmodified save roll of 1 for this unit removes a token once the Attack ability that caused it has finished.
